unsupported_claims: The relational classifier uses the network's label distribution as a feature when neighbors carry usable label information (accepts the false premise)
Mixing attribute features with aggregated neighbor-label features is necessary for performance and generally yields better results than either alone
Conditions listed (homophily, known neighbor labels, insufficient attributes) as when the method relies on label distribution in the feature space
rationale: The source says the proposed approach explicitly avoids mixing the label space into the feature space and learns structural features independent of labels. The answer accepts the false premise and builds its conditions and justification on it without correcting it.
